title: San Pedro De Atacama
intro: Earn the desert instead of watching it through a minibus window.
anchor: Mountain-bike ride through Pukará de Quitor / Catarpe terrain, then a social San Pedro afternoon.
morning: Rent a good mountain bike / helmet after breakfast.
Ride towards Pukará de Quitor and Catarpe / canyon sectors, subject to current access.
afternoon: Return early afternoon. Big lunch, shower, rest.
Wander adobe streets, market, café/bar; meet other travellers heading into Bolivia.
evening: Pack layers, water and essentials for the 4x4 crossing.
No premium “Milky Way” tour - moon still dominates the sky.
logistics: Reconfirm route access locally the day before; desert tracks can close/change.
Keep passport/cash accessible for border next morning.
watchOut: If altitude symptoms are significant, skip the bike and rest. Bolivia is not the place to arrive depleted.
places: Pukará de Quitor, San Pedro de Atacama

title: Bolivian Altiplano
intro: The road effectively ends and the 4x4 becomes your world.
anchor: Border crossing into Bolivia, high-altitude lagoons, Dalí Desert, hot springs and Laguna Colorada in one raw day.
morning: Very early departure San Pedro. Chile exit / Bolivia entry at Hito Cajón.
Transfer into expedition 4x4 with your small group.
afternoon: Laguna Blanca / Verde, surreal desert, geothermal landscapes.
Get into the Polques hot springs rather than just photograph them.
evening: Remote lodge dinner with the 4x4 group.
Cards, wine/tea, conversation; embrace the basicness.
eat: Tour food is included. Carry snacks you actually want to eat.
Coca tea can help with comfort but does not “cure” altitude sickness.
logistics: Book a reputable operator with oxygen and clear vehicle/safety standards.
Remote lodge quality varies - that is part of this section, not a hotel failure.
watchOut: Altitude can exceed 4,500m. Severe headache, vomiting, confusion, breathlessness at rest = descend / seek medical help; do not “push through.”
sleep: Remote Bolivian Altiplano lodge - included with expedition.

title: Bolivian Altiplano
intro: A day that looks like another planet for hours at a time.
anchor: Rock valleys, high lagoons, vicuñas, tiny settlements and the social micro-world of your 4x4 group.
morning: Continue across the high desert. Exact stops depend on operator/route conditions.
afternoon: Valleys of rock, high-altitude wetlands, flamingo lagoons / canyon stops as routing allows.
Do not obsess over mobile signal; this is the point.
evening: Arrive salt hostel / remote lodge near Salar.
Group dinner; early night ahead of the Salar.
eat: Try local quinoa / llama when served, but expedition food is primarily fuel.
logistics: No independent route-planning needed once operator is selected.
Keep batteries warm at night; cold drains them quickly.
watchOut: This is intentionally one of the least luxurious nights of the trip.
sleep: Salt hostel / remote lodge - included with expedition.

title: Salar De Uyuni
intro: White infinity by day; real dark sky before the Moon rises at night.
anchor: Salar de Uyuni + a protected moon-free stargazing window before ~22:44 moonrise.
morning: Early start onto Salar. Sunrise/first light, salt polygons, Isla Incahuasi if route/conditions allow.
Perspective photos: do them; they are silly and genuinely fun here.
afternoon: Hotel, hot shower, food, two-hour reset.
evening: Astronomical darkness begins after ~19:38; moonrise ~22:44 on 30 Sep. Protect ~19:45-22:15 for true dark-sky viewing / telescope / astrophotography.
eat: Early dinner before the night tour or substantial late lunch.
Keep alcohol low: stars + altitude + early flight next day.
logistics: The Uyuni dark-sky window is date-specific and verified from lunar data.
Book a stargazing operator who can explicitly work within the pre-moonrise window.
watchOut: September is dry season: do not expect the mirror-water effect. The reward is huge dark sky and the stark salt surface.
sleep: Uyuni - Casa de Sal / Cristales Joyas de Sal / Jardines de Uyuni.

title: La Paz
intro: You land in a city built in a canyon and then ride above it before watching cholitas wrestle at altitude.
anchor: Mi Teleférico + El Alto / cholet context + Thursday Cholita Wrestling.
morning: Hotel in Calacoto / Zona Sur; light lunch / salteña.
afternoon: Use Mi Teleférico as the city tour: ride from the lower city towards El Alto, understanding the geography from above.
Look at cholet architecture / El Alto context with a reputable guide or organised route.
evening: Thursday = ideal Cholita Wrestling night. Use organised transport/guide; do not improvise solo transport after dark in El Alto.
Late dinner or drink back in Zona Sur.
eat: Must eat: salteña, api if found, anticucho if comfortable with street food.
Dinner option: Arami / Gustu if timing works, but wrestling has priority.
logistics: Stay in Zona Sur rather than chasing a cheaper central room.
Ride teleférico in daylight; organised transport for wrestling.
watchOut: La Paz altitude is ~3,650m and El Alto higher. Take the first hours slowly.
sleep: La Paz - Atix / MET / Casa Grande.

title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: Drop from the Altiplano into ocean, mountains and warm air.
anchor: First Rio sunset from Arpoador - the reset should feel like a cinematic location change.
morning: Fly LPB→GIG, ideally via Santa Cruz on the shortest useful routing.
Arrive Ipanema/Arpoador/Leblon; shower, laundry, clean clothes.
afternoon: Do not “sightsee” hard on arrival. Walk Ipanema, swim, coconut water, acclimatise to sea level.
Use the extra Rio night to protect the group days from weather.
evening: Casual boteco dinner and one caipirinha; no São Paulo detour, no airport rebound next morning.
eat: Save Lasai and the polished meal for when everyone is together.
logistics: São Paulo is deleted as a destination. Rio is the Brazil rendezvous.
Stay in the same Rio hotel through the morning of 8 Oct.
sleep: Rio - Hotel Arpoador / Arena Ipanema / Ritz Leblon.

title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: The group converges in the city that actually looks like the trip of a lifetime.
anchor: Everyone’s first shared Brazil memory is Rio - beach, sunset and a real welcome dinner.
morning: Sahil: slow breakfast and flexible morning around Niki’s arrival.
If Niki arrives early, beach / Leblon walk rather than rushing a landmark.
afternoon: Priyesh & Amisha target Emirates EK247 DXB→GIG, currently 08:05→16:05 schedule pattern.
Airport transfer to Ipanema; shower and reset.
evening: All four to Arpoador / Ipanema for first drinks and beach energy.
Polished Brazilian welcome dinner, then music only if everyone still has energy.
eat: Pão de queijo / pastel / mate / caipirinha.
Dinner should feel Brazilian, not generic hotel luxury.
logistics: Do not pre-book an early-evening non-refundable event. Arrival buffers matter.
sleep: Rio - same hotel; all four together.
decision: TARGET / RECONFIRM — Niki joins directly in Rio
